caption:
When it's hot outside, we sweat more. But what happens when we're always in air-conditioned spaces? We may not sweat as much, but our bodies are still reacting to the heat. 
   Here are some mini steps: 
   drink water when you're out, 
   take breaks in the shade, 
   wear light clothes
